title: The Negreira case, explained
checked: Story broke 15 Feb 2023 (Cadena SER; Wikipedia). Negreira CTA vice-president 1993-2018 (Al Jazeera 3 Oct 2026, Goal 2 Oct 2026; Wikipedia says 1994, so the video only says 'until 2018'). More than EUR 7.3m 2001-2018 to his firms (prosecutors via Al Jazeera, CBS). Club says reports on referees (Al Jazeera, Wikipedia). March 2023 charges: club, Rosell, Bartomeu, Negreira, son; sports corruption, unfair administration, false records (Al Jazeera, Wikipedia, CBS). Real Madrid joined 12 Mar 2023 (Wikipedia, Al Jazeera). Tebas 16 Feb 2023: sporting sanctions time-barred after three years (ESPN, Vozpopuli). Bribery added 28 Sep 2023 (Wikipedia, ESPN); dropped by Barcelona court 24 May 2024, not a public official (Wikipedia, Catalan News). UEFA: confirmed 1 Oct 2026 it is assessing Real Madrid's dossier, about 50,000 pages (Al Jazeera, Goal). Forensic report May 2026: Negreira lacks capacity to follow the proceedings (Yahoo/El Mundo/La Vanguardia, Tribuna). Laporta quote 'Barcelona has never bought referees' (Wikipedia, Dhaka Tribune). No court has ruled any match was fixed; no trial date; titles untouched as of 4 Nov 2026.

lines.text: February 2023. A Spanish radio station drops a bombshell about Barcelona and the referees.
lines.say: February twenty twenty-three. A Spanish radio station drops a bombshell, about Barcelona and the referees.

lines.text: For years, Barça had been paying a company owned by the number two of Spain's referees.
lines.say: For years, Barsah had been paying a company owned by the number two of Spain's referees.

scene.headline: Barcelona paid firm of referees' vice-president
scene.standfirst: The money went to a firm owned by the number two of Spanish refereeing. The club says it bought reports.

lines.text: His name: José María Enríquez Negreira, vice-president of the referees' committee until 2018.
lines.say: His name: Hosay Mareeah Enreeketh Negrayra. Vice-president of the referees' committee, until twenty eighteen.

lines.text: From 2001 to 2018, prosecutors say his firms got more than seven point three million euros.
lines.say: From two thousand and one to twenty eighteen, prosecutors say his firms got more than seven point three million euros.

lines.text: Barcelona's answer: it was paying for reports on referees. Nothing more.
lines.say: Barcelona's answer: it was paying for reports on referees. Nothing more.

scene.heading: Barcelona's explanation
scene.body: The club says the money paid for technical reports on referees. It denies ever trying to influence a match.

lines.text: LaLiga's boss said it was too late anyway. Sporting punishments expire after three years.
lines.say: La Leega's boss said it was too late anyway. Sporting punishments expire after three years.

scene.headline: Too late to punish Barça, says LaLiga chief
scene.standfirst: Javier Tebas says sporting sanctions lapse three years after the events. No points lost, no relegation.

lines.text: Then the courts moved in. In March, prosecutors charged the club, two ex-presidents, Negreira and his son.
lines.say: Then the courts moved in. In March, prosecutors charged the club, two ex-presidents, Negrayra, and his son.

lines.text: Real Madrid joined the case. Then a bribery charge was added, and Laporta was named too.
lines.say: Rayal Madrid joined the case. Then a bribery charge was added, and Laporrtah was named too.

lines.text: Then the twist. In May 2024, a Barcelona court threw the bribery charge out.
lines.say: Then the twist. In May twenty twenty-four, a Barcelona court threw the bribery charge out.

lines.text: Why? The referees' committee isn't a public body, so Negreira wasn't a public official.
lines.say: Why? The referees' committee isn't a public body, so Negrayra wasn't a public official.

scene.heading: Why it was dropped
scene.body: Bribery in Spanish law needs a public official. The court said a referees' committee official is not one. The sports corruption charges carry on.

lines.text: And in October, UEFA confirmed it's reading a fifty thousand page dossier sent by Real Madrid.
lines.say: And in October, Yooayfa confirmed it's reading a fifty thousand page dossier, sent by Rayal Madrid.

scene.headline: UEFA studies Real Madrid's Negreira dossier
scene.standfirst: Its ethics and disciplinary inspectors will assess about 50,000 pages. The review is still open.

lines.text: But the man at the centre may never face a trial. Doctors say his dementia has got worse.
lines.say: But the man at the centre may never face a trial. Doctors say his dementia has got worse.

scene.headline: Negreira unfit to follow his own case
scene.standfirst: A forensic report says the former official can no longer understand the proceedings.

lines.text: Barcelona's president has one line, and he's stuck to it.
lines.say: Barcelona's president has one line, and he's stuck to it.

lines.text: So, November 2026: no trial, no verdict, and every title still stands. The case is still open.
lines.say: So, November twenty twenty-six. No trial, no verdict, and every title still stands. The case is still open.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
